read_from: 78-page multi-discipline set; the cover's drawing index lists fourteen electrical sheets (ES100 .. E800), which are pages 55-68. Every one of those pages is rotation 270 with ZERO text -- no fonts, no words: the text was outlined to paths when the PDF was made. The title blocks are legible in a render (ES100 ELECTRICAL SITE PLAN on page 55) but nothing on them can be read as text, so each is recorded with an empty number and is asserted detected with an unreadable reason -- a sheet with outlined text, like a scan, is surfaced rather than dropped. The title and kind on each entry are read from the render, for the record; the engine cannot read them and the test does not assert them. The pages the engine used to pick instead (0 cover G0.00, 31 A5.03, 37 A9.01, 42 M1.01, 46 M6.01) are non-electrical pages whose body tags (EQ020, EF-7) or drawing index landed in an edge strip
